title: VEL-VIV-JUDGE-01 — the male judge (Vivienne, insecurity angle)

cards.text: VEL-VIV-JUDGE-01 — THE MALE JUDGE (VIVIENNE, INSECURITY ANGLE)

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Greenscreen AI UGC. A young male judge, keyed bottom-left over full-bleed stills and cut by the frame edge, shames women who carry cheap bags: everyone can tell, the outfit was right and the bag gave her away, a cheap bag says she didn't think she was worth the good one. Then the need: the women who get treated differently carry real leather and real hardware, a bag that looks like money. That opens the loop (how am I supposed to afford that), and he closes it: you don't have to spend all that money anymore. This is the Vivienne from Velantra. Then the formula: leather, brass, strap, no logo so nobody can tell what you paid, the corner-office line, capacity, four colors, pre-order sale with the October ship date, link, last jab. No list, no scores, no brand named. 60.5s, one VO take (gringo male clone, take D, 192 wpm), hard cuts, no music.

cards.title: OUR VERSION  ·  VEL-VIV-JUDGE-01 v3 · 60.5s · VO take D (gringo male clone, eleven_v3, 192 wpm) · judge G1 keyed · real stills + QA-passed 8/31 Vivienne frames, no new product generation

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: THE ONE THING
cards.text: Cheap bag = she gave herself away. The judge makes her feel it, tells her the women who get treated differently carry the expensive one, then hands her the way out: you don't have to spend all that money anymore. This is the Vivienne from Velantra.

cards.title: DO
cards.text: Greenscreen key, not a window: judge keyed bottom-left over the b-roll, head a fifth of frame width, cut by the bottom and left edges, one jump to bottom-right on the 'bag that looks like money' beat. Title card through the reversal, then gone. Hard cuts, no music, one VO take. State the October ship date.

cards.title: DON'T
cards.text: No scores, no list, no brand names. No 'structured', 'holds its shape', 'stands on its own' or laptop claims for the Vivienne. No silver hardware. No interior shot. No dimensions spoken.

cards.title: FLAGGED FOR BROOKS
cards.text: 1. Cheap-bag shame is the register you asked for; it overrides the no-wound default for this run. 2. The three shame stills are real Pinterest photos of generic bags (no logo visible), same open licensing ruling as the grid builds. 3. Voice is the existing gringo male clone, not the reference creator's own voice (real person, paid ad). Say the word and I clone him. 4. Male casting on your call for this run.

cards.title: CREATOR + VOICE
cards.text: G1 charcoal tee on flat green is the default (green holds edge to edge on all three). G2 black and G3 heather on the moodboard. Voice: gringo-tiktok-male, eleven_v3, take D, 60.1s, 192 wpm (take C came back at 235 wpm and was dropped). HeyGen Avatar V render fires only after this board is approved.
